categories.name: Veterinary

categories.name: Create

products.name: Note Thyme
products.description: Meal planning with saved recipes, family preferences, and grocery lists.
products.releaseNote: The app is in development. A public release address is not yet confirmed.

products.name: ChoreMouse
products.description: Family chores, points, and rewards with parent approvals and a kids’ view.
products.releaseNote: A demo is open. The full app offers a 7-day trial, then a paid subscription. Full release verification is pending.

products.name: PlainSlang
products.description: Look up modern slang, meanings, and context in a no-login guide for parents.
products.releaseNote: The public guide is open without an account. Browse the glossary and explore slang by topic.

products.name: What List
products.description: Try a grocery-list and meal-planning interface in your browser.
products.releaseNote: Interactive demo only: recipe imports use sample content and lists are not saved between sessions.

products.name: DelQuro Connect
products.description: A workspace for veterinary team huddles, schedules, time off, and communication.
products.releaseNote: Access is arranged for participating clinics. Contact the studio about availability; there is no public self-service launch.

products.name: VetForm GO
products.description: Clinic forms and a protected staff inbox. Pet owners use a form link from their clinic.
products.releaseNote: Staff sign-in is required. Access is arranged with a clinic; pet owners receive individual form links.

products.name: Megatory Live
products.description: A web preview of inventory counting for veterinary teams.
products.releaseNote: The current web preview uses local clock/PIN entry. Shared notebook sync and native release checks are still in progress.

products.name: AI Scripts Library
products.description: Browse eight editable prompt and agent templates and copy a starting point for your next task.
products.releaseNote: A browser-based prototype with local templates. It does not run an AI service or submit prompts to a provider.

products.name: DelQuro Echo
products.description: A communication-assistant project exploring inbox organization and daily summaries.
products.releaseNote: In development. A functioning public app is not yet available.

products.name: GhostForge
products.description: A writing project for developing a manuscript from an idea to a draft.
products.releaseNote: In development. A public release and launch address have not been confirmed.

products.name: DelQuro Zen
products.description: Explore calming sounds and a sleep timer in a mobile-friendly sound-library prototype.
products.releaseNote: A public sound-library prototype. Features and supported devices are still being tested.

products.name: Vibe Coding 101
products.description: An introductory learning project about making apps with AI-assisted coding.
products.releaseNote: The learning project is in development. There is no verified public app destination yet.

products.name: S.O.L.A.R.
products.description: A choose-your-own-adventure learning game for grades K–12.
products.releaseNote: The game is in development. A public release address has not been confirmed.

products.name: CLT Academy
products.description: A Classic Learning Test study project with practice exams, topic drills, and flashcards.
products.releaseNote: In development. Independent study material; not affiliated with Classic Learning Initiatives.

products.name: Cat’s Journey
products.description: An FE and PE Civil exam study guide with quizzes, flashcards, formulas, and local progress.
products.releaseNote: Public study preview with progress stored in your browser. Independent exam preparation; not an official NCEES product.
